Crimson, wraith-like skeleton dripped with blood. Inflicts gory wounds, murderer's spirit. Bound to ritual bottle.

AC 13, HP 22, ATK 2 touch +4 (1d12 + gory wound), MV near (fly), S -4, D +3, C +0, I +0, W +0, Ch +4, AL C, LV 5

Bottle-Bound. A mortal holding the polong's bottle can make an opposed CHA roll to dominate spirit. On failure, spirit is hostile.

Gory Wound. 1d4 damage and 1d4 CON damage each round. CON 12+, stabilize check, or healing to staunch. Die at 0 CON.

Greater Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Incorporeal. In place of attacks, become corporeal or incorporeal.
